notes.title: 🎮 Missing Meows at GDS Prague – Indie Expo! 🐾
notes.content:
Hello dears! I'm excited to announce that a demo of Missing Meows will be available to play at [b]GDS Prague on 13th and 14th[/b] December at the Indie Expo! 😺

Swing by, chat with me and my dear marketing help Hanka, and grab some exclusive [b]stickers[/b]. Can’t wait to see you there! 🐾
